scope: Final authored simulation checkpoint for thumb opposition and anatomical inspection direction. All screenshots are actual production UI/public controls; supplementary Blender hand-only anatomy is identified separately. Finite sampled checks, not clinical/anatomical or AAA certification.

calibrationInput.role: immutable geometry calibration input; not the subsequently rebuilt GLB output hash

diagnosis.independentLeftReference: Pinned ClinicalCraft LEFT hand: distal +Y, radial +X, dorsal +Z; (distal cross radial) dot dorsal = -1. Actual source right triad is opposite; left is obtained by a true reflected transform.
diagnosis.cameraFault: Old inspection radial hint used source-model +Z, 90 degrees from actual palm_frame +Z. Corrected to the anatomical radial frame.
diagnosis.thumbFault: Flat primary contact plus the old index reference permitted the thumb MCP to rise toward the dorsal palm and buried much of the proximal phalanx, despite exact needle contact.
diagnosis.correction: Acquire actual oblique volar terminal skin, retain a source-volar normal dot >=0.5, fit opposition within the existing joint/twist limits and authored radial/palmar MCP envelope; adjust index reference and real handle holding planes, preserving needle axis/entry. C2 opening avoids palm entry. Side-pulp and separate nail-work routes retained.

bounds.note: Existing tolerances retained. The thumb MCP authored envelope applies to refitted ordinary and tripod precision grips; it is not a population ROM constraint and is not imposed on the separate unchanged nail-work route.

anatomicalDirectionAndExposure.scope: Read-only actual approved production hand controller and final GLB. No runtime subclass, prototype/field override or pose injection. Matched8cases retain preserved baseline.00035radius/.5phase; two separate fresh-hand right-handed production.0007radius/.3phase cases are explicitly labelled. Geometric bearings and authored depiction thresholds do not establish clinical ROM or full-parameter clearance.

baseline.comparisonScope: MCP positions/chirality and identical complete34-point source skin rings up to17mm use matched original inputs. The preserved baseline lacks the full204-point2mm..IP−2mm band; no unmatched historical prototype count is promoted to a new matched measurement.

methods.skinRows: Exact exported UV V values recover source along/(total+2.5mm); deduplicate only identical physical seam positions perrow.
methods.occupancy: Actual skinned closed-palm triangles; three independent ray directions, majority parity, nearest-triangle distance. Both rawinside anddepth>50micrometreinside reported.
methods.proximalBand: Complete physical source skin circumferences fromMCP+2mm throughIP−2mm. The metacarpal/CMC root is excluded intentionally.
methods.nails: Actual posed nail centroid displacement transverse to distal bone versus actual fixed volar-centre attachment direction; fullmatrix point transforms retain mirror parity.

directController.scope: Actual final production GLB/controller. Bounded roll -pi..pi and continuous 0..4pi at 3 degree increments; finite wrist, hand and opening combinations. No entire-parameter-space guarantee.

thirdFingerPhysical.method: Actual LBS distal skin with three-ray-majority inside tests and nearest triangles; actual finite 25mm handle/40mm shaft. 288 finite combinations. A tangential single-ray parity false positive was rejected by independent majority rays, without changing the 50um depth threshold.

method.kind: finite chronological CPU reconstruction of the actual public 3D integration scene
method.fixture: Exact makePublicWorkingScene() geometry, appearance, seeds and registration from bimanual-procedure.test.ts; actual production GLB loaded through GLTFLoader.
method.planning: Geometry-based common branch over actual posed acquisition, operation and release samples, cached per gesture. Registration plans may be replaced while reach <= 0.02 when the first actual animated patient skin invalidates them. Invalidating an invisible registration plan clears both cached plan and previous per-frame clearance roll, so the newly checked complete envelope wins selection.
method.authoritativeDisplayedGuard: A fresh independent PatientClearance instance checked the complete currently posed hand model against the actual current patient surface at every visible state. Production contact validity, arm reach and displayed visibility were also observed.

results.needleAxisNote: Maximum axis-vector difference is floating-point roundoff (~1.14e-16), below the unchanged 1e-9 clinical-axis test bound; it is not reported as exact numerical zero.
Maximum axis-vector difference is floating-point roundoff (~1.14e-16), below the unchanged 1e-9 clinical-axis test bound; it is not reported as exact numerical zero.

regressionEvidence.scope: Replacement whole-envelope plan overrides invalidated cached frame roll, restores current pose, and remains stable through normal future advancement without a preview seek.

regressionEvidence.command: npx vitest run packages/server/src/bimanual-procedure.test.ts -t 'three-finger approach, work and retreat continuous'

regressionEvidence.scope: Insertion/removal/procedure and needle-frame regression; wrist-join regression includes both sides and authored 85-degree forearm twist cap.

scopeAndLimitations: This is finite evidence for the specified actual integration scene and chronological samples, not a proof for every anatomy, needle angle, technique or motion setting.
The common clearance envelope is sampled, not a continuous mathematical swept-volume proof. Current actual posed geometry intersections remain authoritative for every displayed frame.

Future catalogue rotation uses sample.rotationRad, which is assigned directly to NeedleLayer body.rotation.y. Future axial pose sampling uses sample.withdrawalMm as a planning estimate; exact future clinical withdrawal may be clamped to retained depth and the actual handle/contact path. The planner never mutates clinical needle geometry.

The 85-degree forearm guard is preserved and covered by the wrist-join regression. The measured per-state wrist statistic here is engaged position error; this artifact does not claim a separate per-state measurement of forearm twist.
No source edits were made while collecting this artifact; hand.ts, physiology, procedure.ts and the final GLB remain bound to the listed SHA256 values.

Regression records explicitly identify the procedure SHA validated. Earlier 62-test and 22-test reports are preserved as prior-source evidence; the final cache fix passed all 44 bimanual tests, the new focused regression, and a fresh measured 121-state reconstruction for each hand.

cacheInvalidationRegression.method: The new regression imports real production placeHand and substitutes only a controlled current/future PatientClearance oracle, isolating cache selection rather than duplicating the implementation.

before.method: Independent review agent imported the exact pre-fix a3c873 source text through an isolated temporary module; no production source rollback was performed.

cacheInvalidationRegression.scope: Controlled regression proves the stale cache failure and correction. Actual patient mesh evidence is separately recorded by the finite production integration reconstruction.

stageCheck.method: Fresh StageBundle equals actual8795HTTP response; all ten runtime source hashes stable

actualUi.scope: Actual production UI and public controls. Full practitioner retained, no geometry substitution, private camera, scene hiding or image retouch; native rAF waits after public seeks. Software WebGL evidence, not AAA certification.

supplementaryHandOnly.scope: Supplementary technical hand-only render, not an actual clinical UI capture. No patient/actor image was hidden or retouched to create this figure.

snapshot.method: Unmodified production ArticulatedHand.pose; actual Three Mesh.getVertexPosition/SkinnedMesh.applyBoneTransform world geometry and normal field. No clip substituted for a runtime pose.
snapshot.normalMethod: Original exported vertex normals transformed by the actual linear skin matrices then inverse-transpose world normal matrix; left negative determinant faces reversed as the Three renderer front-face convention requires.
snapshot.topologyAndUV: Source vertex count/order and complete triangle topology retained; original TEXCOORD_0 and embedded PNG payloads copied unchanged.
snapshot.geometryAlterations: None except rigid view rotation/translation and the same uniform display scale for every panel. No sculpting, subdivision, smoothing modifier, finger separation or pose override.

materials.method: Original glTF PBR material graphs/textures imported unchanged by Blender from actual-pose GLBs. Runtime baseColor/metallic/roughness factors recorded; no later Blender shader edits.
materials.normalMapConvention: Original glTF normalTexture scale retained. The generated-tangent Three normalScale Y sign is recorded in the full snapshot, not double-applied.

supplementaryHandOnly.annotations: Direction/side/pose labels and leader lines to actual thumb MCP projections only. No image retouch.

visualReview.observed: Left/right anatomy mirrors correctly; four fingers curl toward the palmar side while the thumb opposes them. The two thumb bends turn in the same plane; no reverse distal bend is indicated by the captured joint geometry.
visualReview.remainingLimitations: This is a procedural hand with an overlapping thumb/palm skin construction, not a seamless anatomical soft-tissue union. A visible thenar/proximal-thumb ridge/tubular contour remains, and the back of the hand is simplified. These renders do not establish AAA photorealism, clinical calibration or absence of overlap.

thumbPalmOccupancyReference.method: Complete physical source skin circumferences fromMCP+2mm throughIP−2mm. The metacarpal/CMC root is excluded intentionally.; Actual skinned closed-palm triangles; three independent ray directions, majority parity, nearest-triangle distance. Both rawinside anddepth>50micrometreinside reported.
thumbPalmOccupancyReference.importantInterpretation: 70/204 Tip and20/204 Tripod count samples INSIDE the actual palm beyond50um; they are not exposed-sample counts or a claim of zero thumb/palm overlap.

verification.standaloneProductionBuilds: Two byte-identical builds; all 19 authored asset tests pass.

historicalEvidence.wrist: WRIST-JOIN-VALIDATION.json is the preceding 0777d310 source checkpoint. It is preserved without rewriting its source identities. New geometry/index/PBR/binds are identical; poses and camera differ.

limits: Authored geometry and finite checks do not establish clinical technique fidelity, anatomical motion tracking or force/tissue mechanics.
Separate side-pulp/nail-work branches retain their prior behavior; the new thumb MCP envelope covers the ordinary/tripod routes.

Source carpal/metacarpal thumb tissue remains intentionally embedded in thenar palm. The production default proximal skin band still overlaps the palm at 70/204 samples (maximum 7.618mm depth) for Tip55 and 20/204 (3.942mm) for Tripod48. The thumb silhouette is improved but the separate skin surfaces do not form a validated anatomical tissue union.
Full practitioner and body occlusions remain in UI captures. The hand-only Blender render is a supplementary geometry inspection, not a clinical scene screenshot.
Wrist/sleeve loft is not a physically simulated wrist or cloth system; earlier documented shading/crease and wrist-frame residual limits remain.
Software WebGL captures do not establish target-GPU performance, AAA fidelity or live paid-model behavior.
